message: Congenital. The problem's very common to small dogs, especially corgis, who can get so used to it that they'll simply kick their back leg outwards while running to snap the kneecap back into place. Tink does the same thing, but more slowly: think of doing a bent-over hip extension and that's her, with the right leg way out to the back. The problem's not uncommon in cats, apparently.
